title: Tips and Tricks of Building a Sustainable Biological EM Facility
content: Since the 1990s, many academic institutions have consolidated imaging instruments such as confocal and electron microscopes into centralized core facilities. This model optimizes instrument usage, enables cost-sharing through a fee-for-service approach, and ensures proper maintenance. Core facility staff play a crucial role in not only managing and maintaining these instruments but also providing user training and, in some cases, dedicated imaging analysis support.
